# Spinics.net

> > A diverse web portal featuring iLovePDF tools across multiple domains, TV Guide listings and streaming recommendations, Know Your Meme viral culture documentation, and Rick Ellis's large format photography portfolio.

Spinics.net appears to be a multi-purpose web portal hosting several distinct properties: iLovePDF (PDF conversion and editing tools with AI chat features), TV Guide (television schedules and streaming content recommendations), Know Your Meme (viral internet culture documentation), and photography resources. The site serves audiences across multiple languages including English, Portuguese, and Chinese.

## Key Topics

- iLovePDF - PDF conversion and editing tools
- PDF to Word/Excel/JPG conversion
- Netflix and streaming recommendations
- TV schedules and live sports listings
- Know Your Meme - viral internet culture
- TikTok trends and memes
- Large format photography by Rick Ellis
- GPT-5 nano AI chat integration
- OCR (Optical Character Recognition)
- Document security and encryption
- Yosemite National Park photography
- March 2026 TV season guides
- Viral videos and catchphrases
- Streaming services (Netflix, Hulu, Peacock)

## PDF Tools & Conversion

- [iLovePDF English | AI Chat & PDF Tools Overview](https://ilovepdf.io): English homepage with AI chatbot and comprehensive PDF tool directory
- [iLovePDF: Free PDF Converter & Online Tools | Edit, Compress, Merge Files](https://ilovepdf.com.cn/en): English homepage for iLovePDF.com.cn with PDF conversion and editing tools
- [iLovePDF | ferramentas online para PDF para os amantes de PDF](https://ilovepdf.com/pt): Portuguese homepage for iLovePDF's free PDF tools (merge, split, compress)
- [iLovePDF Brasil | Chat com IA e visão geral das ferramentas PDF](https://ilovepdf.com.br): Brazilian homepage featuring GPT-5 nano AI chat and PDF tool links
- [I Love PDF | Converter PDF para Word (DOCX), PDF para Excel (XLSX), PDF para JPG online gratuitamente](https://ilovepdf.love/pt): Portuguese PDF converter emphasizing privacy with client-side processing
- [Ferramentas gratuitas de conversão de PDF | Converta PDFs online](https://ilovepdf.biz/pt): Portuguese PDF tools homepage offering free conversion and editing features
- [Proteger PDF. Ferramenta para encriptar PDFs com senha](https://ilovepdf.com/pt/proteger-pdf): PDF encryption tool page for password-protecting documents securely

## TV Listings & Streaming Guides

- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Streaming Services, Entertainment News and Celebrity News](https://tvguide.com): Homepage with streaming recommendations, TV listings, and entertainment news
- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Online Videos, Entertainment News and Celebrity News](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV schedule and listings page for finding what to watch tonight
- [Live Sports On TV Today](https://tvguide.com/sports/live-today): Daily live sports schedule across MLB, NBA, NHL, and soccer leagues
- [The 55 Best Shows on Netflix Right Now (March 2026)](https://tvguide.com/news/the-best-shows-on-netflix): Curated list of top 55 Netflix shows including Vladimir and The Night Agent
- [The 61 Best Movies on Netflix Right Now (March 2026)](https://tvguide.com/news/best-movies-on-netflix): Netflix movie recommendations featuring Jurassic World Rebirth and The Iron Claw
- [The Complete Guide to Winter TV 2025-2026](https://tvguide.com/news/features/winter-tv-guide-2025): Comprehensive winter TV season guide with Stranger Things and Game of Thrones
- [Cary, NC TV Guide - Tonight's Antenna, Cable or Satellite TV Schedule](https://tvguide.com/listings/zip/27518-cary-nc): Local TV listings for Cary, NC antenna and cable providers
- [The 16 Best Movies to Watch on Peacock Right Now (March 2026)](https://tvguide.com/news/best-movies-on-peacock): Peacock movie recommendations including Oscar nominees Hamnet and Bugonia
- [The New Shows of the 2026 Winter TV Season](https://tvguide.com/galleries/the-new-shows-of-the-2025-2026-winter-tv-season): Gallery of new winter 2026 TV shows from Game of Thrones and Star Trek
